title: instantsearch with Angular - How to Geo search ?

comments.body: @odecharette let me know if I can close this issue.

The aroundRadius is based on where the center of the search is, so I'm not quite sure how the "perimetre" of each result fits in this case. Maybe you could contact the support directly because it sounds like a broader question related to search and not InstantSearch.js specifically?
@odecharette, how did you integrate geosearch with angular?

Hello @bryyyanribo, we have a dedicated guide about [geo search + Angular InstantSearch](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/resources/ui-and-ux-patterns/in-depth/geo-search/angular/) inside the documentation. Note that this guide apply to the version 3 of Angular InstantSearch that is currently in beta. Anyway the concepts applied to the version 2.

@samouss, I was having an issue as to how to pass the data from my current location on this one: 
https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/api-parameters/aroundLatLng/
You can use the [`ais-configure`](https://www.algolia.com/doc/api-reference/widgets/configure/angular/) widget to provide the location to `aroundLatLng`.
